title: Breakfast
description: Hannah French presents Radio 3's Breakfast show. To get in touch, email 3breakfast@bbc.co.uk.

title: Saturday Morning
description: Tom Service has the perfect weekend classical soundtrack! Pianist Olga Pashchenko plays live on our studio piano, and Scottish mezzo Beth Taylor talks about her musical journey.

title: Earlier... with Jools Holland
description: Jools is joined by the author and film producer Olivia Harrison.

title: Key Changes: Radio 3's Essential History of Classical Music
description: 1889, Paris. After hearing Javanese gamelan at the Paris Exposition, Claude Debussy begins reimagining the possibilities of western classical music.

title: Record Review
description: Andrew McGregor with the best new classical releases, joined by Alice Farnham and Nigel Simeone, who surveys recordings of Rachmaninov's The Bells and makes a top recommendation.

title: Sound of Cinema
description: The best in film music and screen soundtracks, with Edith Bowman- this week composer Lorne Balfe joins Edith to talk about his score to the upcoming release of The Cat in the Hat.

title: This Classical Life
description: Jess Gillam is joined by the percussionist Joby Burgess for a listening party, including music by Peter Gabriel, Caroline Shaw, and Henryk Górecki.

title: Opera on 3
description: Peter Hoare stars as the drunken landlord catapulted to the moon and 15th-century Prague in Janácek's comic opera from the Bregenz Festival. Robert Jindra conducts.

title: New Generation Artists
description: A chance to hear specially recorded performances from Radio 3 New Generation Artists Lukas Sternath, the Leonkoro Quartet and baritone Andrew Hamilton.

title: Music Planet
description: Kathryn Tickell presents the best in global roots-based music, and members of Berlin-based band Mitsune share three tracks showcasing the Japanese shamisen.

title: New Music Show
description: Highlights from this week's event celebrating achievements in contemporary classical composition.

title: Through the Night
description: Stravinsky's 'Le Sacre du Printemps' and Bartók's Second Piano Concerto with the WDR Symphony Orchestra, Cologne and conductor Hannu Lintu.

title: Breakfast
description: Mark Forrest presents Radio 3's Breakfast show. To get in touch, email 3breakfast@bbc.co.uk.

title: Sunday Morning
description: Sarah Walker with three hours of classical music to reflect, restore and refresh whether you're out for a bracing walk or keeping cosy at home.

title: Private Passions
description: The fashion designer Paul Smith shares his musical passions with Michael Berkeley.

title: Music Map
description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch explores Ponchielli's 'Dance of the Hours' from his most famous opera, La Gioconda.

title: Music Matters: The President and the Polka
description: Justin Webb (Today and Americast presenter) explores the relationship between classical music and American political history. Today, the musical influence of immigrants and emigrés.

title: Jazz Record Requests
description: Alyn spins your requests, including a focus on saxophones & trumpets with music from Enrico Rava, Kim Cypher and Ronnie Scott, plus a jazz-orientated gem from Joni Mitchell.

title: The Early Music Show
description: Giovanni Antonini directs his ensemble Il Giardino Armonico in music by Vivaldi, Albinoni and Haydn at Melk Abbey on the banks of the River Danube in Austria.

title: Choral Evensong
description: A service from Blackburn Cathedral, with music by Ed Jones, Howells, Martin Bussey and Vierne.

title: Between the Ears: Silent Teachers
description: Composer Jay Capperauld creates a new work inspired by these 'silent teachers' the students who study them and the head anatomist who holds an annual service for their families.

title: Sunday Feature: New Generation Thinkers shorts
description: Novelist Yiyun Li, musician and Radio 3 Unwind host Niall Breslin and music historian Stacy Jarvis discuss the history and the revival of interest in nocturnes.

title: Words and Music
description: The season of Advent begins, a time of preparation and watchfulness in the liturgical calendar, and a time of year when we might look inward with a sense of possibility ahead.

title: Brass Banding with Hannah Peel
description: Hannah speaks to members of Cornwall's Porthleven Town Band who have gained a loyal fanbase on social media.

title: Night Tracks
description: Sara Mohr-Pietsch presents an adventurous, immersive soundtrack for late-night listening, from classical to contemporary and everything in between.

title: Unclassified
description: Elizabeth Alker picks new releases from the world of ambient music. Also, Stuart Murdoch of Belle and Sebastian is in the Listening Chair to select a track that transports him.

title: Through the Night
description: Lucile Boulanger directs the Consort Les Lucioles in this concert, which celebrates Purcell's 17th-century fantasias composed for the viola ensemble.
